# Luxury HB Home

> A licensed 4-bedroom Huntington Beach vacation rental that sleeps 7. It has a Brunswick Gold Crown pool table, a BBQ island, and a spa-style primary suite. The beach is about 8 minutes away. Book only on Airbnb.

Luxury HB Home is an entire house in Huntington Beach, California 92649 (permit STR-2025-0006). It is rated 5.0 from 10 Airbnb reviews and is an Airbnb Guest Favorite hosted by a Superhost. It is a fit for groups of up to 7, families, festival weekends, and travel nurses or remote workers who want a real kitchen and a workspace.

## At a glance
- Sleeps: 7
- Layout: 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms
- Pool table: Brunswick Gold Crown, plus an electronic dartboard
- Games and TV: Nintendo Switch 2, board games, 82-inch TV with wireless surround sound
- Outdoor: BBQ island under a louvered pergola, lounge seating, grassy yard
- Primary suite: soaking tub, rain shower and double sinks
- Work: dedicated workspace and fast Wi-Fi
- Laundry: in-unit washer and dryer
- Parking: free on-site parking and a Tesla Level 2 charger
- Climate: air conditioning
- Kitchen: quartz counters, stainless appliances, dining for the group
- Utilities: included
- Stays: up to 30 nights; weekly stays get 5% off on Airbnb
- Check-in / checkout: 4:00 p.m. / 11:00 a.m.
- Booking: only through Airbnb. No off-platform payment.

## Location and distances
Approximate off-peak drive times from the house:
- Nearest beach: about 8 minutes
- Huntington Beach Pier, Pacific City, and Main Street: about 10–15 minutes
- Sunset Beach and Bolsa Chica: about 10 minutes
- Seal Beach: about 15 minutes
- Disneyland and California Adventure: about 25 minutes
- Knott's Berry Farm: about 20–25 minutes
- Aquarium of the Pacific, Long Beach: about 25 minutes
- Orange Coast Medical Center: about 15 minutes
- Hoag Hospital Newport Beach: about 20 minutes
- UCI Medical Center: about 20–25 minutes
- Long Beach Memorial: about 20–25 minutes

- [Huntington Beach bike path and e-bike rules](https://hbvacationhome.com/blog/huntington-beach-bike-path-e-bike-rules/): paved beach path about 8.4 miles from Bolsa Chica State Beach to the Santa Ana River; e-bikes allowed on the paved path since April 2021, never on the sand; HBMC 13.08.280 limit 10 mph (5 mph when pedestrians present, 2.5 mph walking pace when yellow lights flash); no riding on the Pier or Pier Plaza, walk bikes and lock only at racks (13.08.290); helmets for all riders under 18 and all Class 3 riders; no Class 3 under 16 (impoundable); Santa Ana River Trail (OC Parks) allows Class 1 and 2 only at 10 mph; City e-bike citations $150 first offense since 2023; night riding needs front white light and reflectors; house does not provide bikes and is a short drive from the path.
- [Fishing the Huntington Beach Pier: no license needed](https://hbvacationhome.com/blog/fishing-huntington-beach-pier-no-license/): CDFW lists the Huntington Beach Pier as a public pier, so no fishing license is needed on it at any age (size/bag limits, seasons and report cards still apply; beach/surf fishing from the sand needs a license at 16+, 2026: $21.09 one day, $32.40 two days); city code HBMC 13.08.320 bans overhead casting over the top rail, more than 2 lines or 2 traps per person (traps attended), poles more than 4 ft into the walkway, cleaning fish on benches/deck/rails and feeding wildlife; pier closed midnight-5 a.m. (13.08.240); 2026-27 spiny lobster season Oct 2, 2026 6 p.m. to Mar 17, 2027, Spiny Lobster Report Card $12.70 required on the pier (kids under 16 too), max 2 hoop nets from a public pier, 7 lobsters at 3 1/4 in carapace; OEHHA advisory south of Seal Beach Pier: women 18-49 and children should not eat black croaker or Pacific barracuda, jacksmelt and Pacific chub mackerel are safest; house is 10-15 minutes' drive from the pier, sleeps 7, full kitchen + BBQ island.
